entities.summary: Leader of Holy See (1963–1978). Concluded Vatican II; Humanae Vitae 1968 (reaffirmed contraception ban, most controversial encyclical of 20th century); abolished Index of Forbidden Books; first pope to visit all 6 continents; reform
